events.public_title: Would escalation force Russia to capitulate in Ukraine?
events.technical_question: Will Trump's Kellogg-style escalation-to-deescalate produce Russian capitulation in Ukraine negotiations?
events.falsifier: Russia yields on core Ukraine terms attributable to Kellogg-style escalation-to-deescalate.
events.confirmation_criteria: No Russian capitulation under escalatory arms surge; Moscow holds core lines.
events.anchor_excerpt: And about a week ago, Putin's spokesman, Putin's foreign policy aid rather, Yuri Ushakov, said that the Russians are no longer waiting for the Americans to implement the Anchorage Agreement. It has become clear to the Russians that the Anchorage Agreement will not be implemented. And what the Russians are now doing instead is waiting for the military victory on the Ukrainian battlefields which will be achieved by their army.

events.why_it_matters: Tests whether Mercouris read Russian war termination as battlefield victory rather than negotiated yield to Western escalation.
